name: ballerina/jwt
description: This module provides a framework for authentication/authorization with JWTs and generation/validation of JWTs as specified in the [RFC 7519](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7519), [RFC 7515](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7515), and [RFC 7517](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7517).

typeDefs.name: SigningAlgorithm
typeDefs.description: Represents the cryptographic algorithms used to secure the JWS.

fields.name: alg
fields.description: Cryptographic algorithm used to secure the JWS

fields.name: typ
fields.description: Media type of the JWT

fields.name: cty
fields.description: Content type, convey structural information about the JWT

fields.name: kid
fields.description: Key ID, hint indicating which key was used to secure the JWS

fields.name: iss
fields.description: Issuer, identifies the principal that issued the JWT

fields.name: sub
fields.description: Subject, identifies the principal that is the subject of the JWT

fields.name: aud
fields.description: Audience, identifies the recipients that the JWT is intended for

fields.name: exp
fields.description: Expiration time, identifies the expiration time (seconds since the Epoch) on or after which the JWT must not be accepted

fields.name: nbf
fields.description: Not before, identifies the time (seconds since the Epoch) before which the JWT must not be accepted

fields.name: iat
fields.description: Issued at, identifies the time (seconds since the Epoch) at which the JWT was issued

fields.name: jti
fields.description: JWT ID, unique identifier for the JWT

typeDefs.name: Error
typeDefs.description:
Represents the error type of the module. This will be returned if an error occurred while issuing/validating a JWT
or any operation related to JWT auth providers.

typeDefs.name: ClientSelfSignedJwtAuthProvider
typeDefs.description: Provides authentication based on the provided JWT configurations.

functions.name: init
functions.description: Provides authentication based on the provided JWT configurations.

functions.name: generateToken
functions.description:
Issues a self-signed JWT for authentication.
```ballerina
string token = check provider.generateToken();
```

return.description: Generated token or else a `jwt:Error` if an error occurred

typeDefs.name: ListenerJwtAuthProvider
typeDefs.description: Provides authentication based on the provided JWT.

functions.name: init
functions.description: Provides authentication based on the provided JWT.

functions.name: authenticate
functions.description:
Authenticates the provided JWT.
```ballerina
boolean result = check provider.authenticate("<credential>");
```

return.description: `jwt:Payload` if authentication is successful or else a `jwt:Error` if an error occurred

functions.name: issue
functions.description:
Issues a JWT based on the provided configurations. JWT will be signed (JWS) if `crypto:KeyStore` information is
provided in the `jwt:KeyStoreConfig` and the `jwt:SigningAlgorithm` is not `jwt:NONE`.
```ballerina
string jwt = check jwt:issue(issuerConfig);
```

return.description: JWT as a `string` or else a `jwt:Error` if an error occurred

functions.name: validate
functions.description:
Validates the provided JWT, against the provided configurations.
```ballerina
jwt:Payload result = check jwt:validate(jwt, validatorConfig);
```

parameters.name: jwt
parameters.description: JWT that needs to be validated

return.description: `jwt:Payload` or else a `jwt:Error` if an error occurred

functions.name: decode
functions.description:
Decodes the provided JWT into the header and payload.
```ballerina
[jwt:Header, jwt:Payload] [header, payload] = check jwt:decode(jwt);
```

parameters.name: jwt
parameters.description: JWT that needs to be decoded

return.description: The `jwt:Header` and `jwt:Payload` as a tuple or else a `jwt:Error` if an error occurred
